question: Fill in the blank (2) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is '**broaden**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the expansive and enriching nature of literature.
 
• The appropriate verb should convey the idea of increasing or extending the scope of one's perspectives.
 
• "**Broaden**" fits well as it aligns with the concept of widening perspectives and gaining new insights.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Constrict (संकुचित करना):** "Constrict" means to narrow or restrict, which is contrary to the intended meaning of expanding perspectives.
 
• **Disregard (अनदेखा करना):** "Disregard" means to ignore or neglect, which does not fit the context of discussing the enriching impact of literature.
 
• **Collude (सांठगांठ करना): **"Collude" means to conspire secretly, which is unrelated to the theme of the passage.
